animation.pixelEquality: All decoded frame RGB hashes equal the raw PNG input frames.
animation.timing: Original screenshot-request start deltas at 1ms timebase; explicit 120ms final-frame hold, loop forever.

retainedPartialCases.cause: Setup trust action was not accepted; actual trust prompt remained visible, plugin absent, zero visual cases. Guarded quit, no mutation replay. Added native focus, explicit prompt/index readiness and one actual DOM-button activation; fresh final runs passed.
Controller attempted to locate a native macOS context menu in page DOM; no template created.
Controller required deprecated active-leaf identity after dashboard reveal; inspected visible loaded dashboard, then added explicit activation.
Controller treated contentEl itself as a descendant root; corrected owned-root scoping.
Real spacious-medium overflow and collapsed-card clipping on prior source 739b5c4; both repaired and reverified.

boundaries: Default Obsidian theme only, current public macOS host; no other OS/community-theme/device claim.
Viewport pixels plus whole-grid geometry; not every below-fold widget pixel is shown.
Template picker entry invoked directly because native context menu is outside page CDP.
Contact sheets are labeled/scaled derivatives for Pi inspection; originals and published selected PNGs are unretouched.
Prior galleries and earlier smoke source bindings remain unchanged.
